canonical_project: Khazna Riyadh data center (first Saudi facility)
notes: Khazna (G42/Mubadala JV) announced entry into Saudi Arabia with a first data center in Riyadh of 20 MW initial capacity (Dec 2025, per AGBI/MENA Startup Digest), first phase of a planned hyperscale network. Note: some December 2025 coverage describes Khazna's first Saudi campus as a 225,000 sqm 200 MW land purchase in Dammam (Eastern Province), so the Riyadh facility status is flagged as uncertain; no ground-breaking confirmed.
